draft_en.subject: Managed switches for your electrical and AV installations - two numbers, and what we do not carry
draft_en.body:
Hi Nikolas,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "Updated Ethernet Switches Links" on 16 February 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

For the managed switches in your electrical and AV installations, from single units, EXW, 15-day validity, CE/RoHS: 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, L2+ managed with VLAN, Marvell-based - model STC-28DGGPM - $84.1 USD; 24 x Gigabit + 4 x 10G SFP+, L2+ managed - STC-424XGGM - $132.7. HDMI-over-IP with USB we do not carry - said up front, so you keep that part with your current source.

One question: which port count does your current project need - 8 at the room end, or 24 in the rack?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
